title: Dominic and the Will
author: Yara Amberdale
blurb: Mirabel Villalobos, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
